verdict.rationale: Pika documents reusable characters that can be used repeatedly across creations, built from a character sheet made from a description, traits or reference image. It also offers a Short Film app that builds a script, storyboard and multi-shot film from set style and references, plus clip continuation from the final frame to keep the scene moving. Together these address cross-shot character and scene consistency, but only through brief vendor marketing lines. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how consistency is held across separately generated shots (e.g. scene or environment locking), any independent or hands-on corroboration that characters actually stay consistent, and depth on limits or failure modes.
